research.VOIDGATE.title: The Void Gate
research.VOIDGATE.stage.1:
The labyrinths of the void were never meant to be visited only once. With the pages of the journal gathered, you understand how the rifts were opened, and how to open one of your own.
Raise sixteen Void Gate Rings standing upright, a circle seven blocks across with nothing inside, and set an Expedition Terminal on the ground two blocks in front of or behind its lowest segment. Touch the ring or the terminal with a caster: the ring lights up and the void horizon fills it. Take any part away and the horizon collapses.
The terminal sets how deep and how dangerous the expedition is. Step into the horizon to set out. In every labyrinth a Void Sigil waits in the key room: carry it to the central portal to go on, and the void offers you one of three gifts. The gifts last only while the expedition does. In the last labyrinth there is no sigil to bring: its guardian must fall.
Die, and the expedition is lost with its gifts, though you keep what you carry. Sneak into a portal that will not open to give it up. Reach the end, and the void rewards you with treasure and Void Shards, which the terminal takes for an extra life, a gift to start with or a focus of the void. The void tires quickly: no more than two expeditions a day.

voidexpeditions.ponder.void_expedition.t: Step into the horizon: the void takes you through a chain of labyrinths, as many as the terminal says
In each labyrinth a Void Sigil waits in the key room. Carry it to the portal in the middle to go on
The portal offers three gifts of the void: pick one. Gifts stack, and last only while the expedition does
The last labyrinth has no sigil: open its boss room with the runed tablet and defeat the guardian
Come back with treasure and Void Shards. Dying loses the expedition and its gifts, but not what you carry
